title: International Version Relay
body_html:
1. MT2503 solution, anti-detection
2. Support mobile phone Android and Apple APP query function
3. Read the location information, satellite number and main power status through B/S and mobile APP client
4. Support SMS parameter setting and query function
5. Support base station assisted positioning function, Beidou positioning function, support low power mode
6. Support Chinese address resolution function
7. Support automatic storage of blind spots and make-up report function
8. Support SMS alarm function
The main function
1. GSM, GPS, Beidou
2. Anti-detection
3. Electronic fence
4. Shift alarm
5. Speeding alarm
6. Vibration alarm
7. Sleep power saving mode
